pull.title: Add type hints and arithmetic operations
pull.body: Adds type annotations to all functions and implements `power` and `modulo` operations.

files.patch:
@@ -1,16 +1,24 @@
-def add(a, b):
+def add(a: float, b: float) -> float:
     return a + b
 
 
-def subtract(a, b):
+def subtract(a: float, b: float) -> float:
     return a - b
 
 
-def multiply(a, b):
+def multiply(a: float, b: float) -> float:
     return a * b
 
 
-def divide(a, b):
+def divide(a: float, b: float) -> float:
     if b == 0:
         raise ValueError("Cannot divide by zero")
     return a / b
+
+
+def power(base: float, exponent: int) -> float:
+    return base ** exponent
+
+
+def modulo(dividend: float, divisor: float) -> float:
+    return dividend % divisor

commit.message: Add type hints and power/modulo operations
Simplify power and modulo using built-in operators

reviews.body: Please add docstrings to each function.

topComments.body: Overall looks good! The type hints are a nice addition.
This is a duplicate of last week's PR.

nodes.body: This loop runs in O(b) time. Python has a built-in `**` operator.
